senses.gloss:
Romaśā is mentioned in the Bṛhaddevatā^1 as the wife of king
Bhāvayavya, and is credited with the authorship of a Rigvedic
verse.^2 But in reality the word romaśā in that verse, which is
the source of the legend, is merely an adjective meaning ‘hairy.’
1) iii. 156 et seq., with Macdonell's
notes.
2) i. 126, 7.
Cf. Oldenberg, Ṛgveda-Noten, 1, 128.
